title: Capturing failure mechanisms toward the rational design of reversible vanadium oxide-based zinc batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9230-9239
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03635F, Paper
Open Access

Xuesong Xie, Yang Yang, Yifan Li, Rohit Sinha, Xuehai Tan, Keren Jiang, Minggang Xie, Yuxuan Xue, Ning Chen, Zhi Li
We investigate failure mechanisms driven by chemical and electrochemical processes through ex situ/in situ techniques and theoretical simulations, and propose rational design strategies for reversible vanadium oxide-based Zn batteries.
